Name: Joja Milk and Other Such Things
Author: bezajel
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45798/45798-1777869678-641731900.png[/img][/center]

[size=4][font=Verdana][color=#d4d4d8]Barn and Coop full of Joja Animals? They should be producing Joja Animal Products! Now your milk, eggs, cheese, and mayo can have that Healthy® Joja Glow, while staying fresh in tastefully branded packaging![/color][/font][/size]

[font=Verdana][color=#d4d4d8][size=3]This mod retextures sprites of animal products and their associated artisan goods to fit into a Joja playthrough.[/size][/color][/font]



[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45798/45798-1777869679-478076706.gif[/img][/center]


[font=Verdana]Includes Joja sprites for:[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Verdana]Milk and Goat's Milk (Small and Large)[/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana]Brown and White Chicken Eggs (Small and Large)[/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana]Duck, Dinosaur, and Ostrich Eggs[/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana]Duck Feather and Rabbit's Foot[/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana]Cheese, Goat's Cheese, Mayonnaise, Duck Mayonnaise, and Dinosaur Mayonnaise[/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana]Wool and Cloth[/font][/*]
[/list]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45798/45798-1777869683-1044842849.png[/img][/center]

[font=Verdana][color=#d4d4d8][size=4]Unzip the file and place in your Mods folder.[/size][/color][/font]
[color=#d4d4d8][size=3][font=Verdana][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] is a required dependency.[/font][/size][/color]


[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45798/45798-1777869684-1099634229.png[/img][/center]

[font=Verdana][color=#d4d4d8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Compatibility Menu (GMCM)[/url] is recommended for configuration of the mod. If you prefer to manually edit, the config.json will be generated the first time you run the mod, and all config options take "true" or "false" as input. All options are true (enabled) by default.[/color][/font]

[list]
[*][font=Verdana][color=#d4d4d8]EnableMod - enable or disable the entire mod.[/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][color=#d4d4d8]Animal Produce section - individually enable or disable each type of animal product.[/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][color=#d4d4d8]Artisan Goods section - individually enable or disable each type of artisan goods.[/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][color=#d4d4d8]RenameJojaItems - change the name and description of any enabled products.[/color][/font][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][font=Verdana]JojaItemColourTags - change the colour context tags of enabled products. This affects dyeing results and Qi's Prismatic Grange quest.[/font][/color][/*]
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45798/45798-1777869687-1186131173.png[/img][/center]

[font=Verdana][color=#d4d4d8]As all changes can be individually enabled or disabled, this mod should be compatible with other retextures if you want to mix and match.[/color][/font]
[font=Verdana][color=#d4d4d8]I made the mod to use in conjunction with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44160]Crucifigo's Joja Animals Expanded[/url].[/color][/font]
[color=#d4d4d8][font=Verdana]Drop me a comment if you would like to suggest compatibility with any other mods.[/font][/color]


[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45798/45798-1777871527-1246654574.png[/img][/center]

[font=Verdana][color=#D4D4D8]Eggs are recoloured from vanilla sprites (except brown eggs, which I added speckles to).[/color][/font]

[font=Verdana][color=#D4D4D8]All other sprites are my own original artwork. Permission is required for further use, and credit must be given.[/color][/font]

[font=Verdana][color=#D4D4D8]Tiny font ("and other such things") is also my own design.[/color][/font]

[font=Verdana][color=#D4D4D8]Banners created using kdau's [url=https://www.kdau.com/scrollish/]Stardew Scroll Generator[/url] and vanilla assets.[/color][/font]

[color=#D4D4D8][font=Verdana]Many thanks to the peeps in making-mods-general who helped my troubleshoot when I tried an (unsuccessful) alternate method. (And modded-stardew for demanding joja milk).[/font][/color]


[font=Verdana][color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Translations[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[font=Verdana][color=#d4d4d8]You may post translated i18n files on their own Nexus page, or share them for me to include in the mod ([url=https://smapi.io/json]https://smapi.io/json[/url]).[/color][/font]
[font=Verdana][color=#d4d4d8]My preference is for human-made translations. Machine translations may NOT collect DP points.[/color][/font]


[font=Verdana][color=#d4d4d8][size=4][b]Bugs[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[color=#d4d4d8][font=Verdana]If you encounter any problems, please describe what you did (to install the mod, and in game actions) and what the result was. Attach your log even if there is no visible error ([url=https://smapi.io/log]https://smapi.io/log[/url]).[/font][/color]
